title: RS12: elementary truncated QPE with one globally reusable gradient

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and fixed secret s modulo N, n=ceil(log2N), the SAME truncated-QPE reusable-gradient RS12 program, stronger exact coins and critical additive-quota configuration in proof.md and recycle-sieve.md recover the entire s with unconditional probability at least1019/1024 under independent ideal coset copies. All four resource bounds and the exact-zero count law hold jointly on EVERY execution branch, including failed draws, discarded copies, wrong-label transcripts and aborts. total charged sequential work T is O(n^(9/2)2^((45156545581/20000000000)sqrt(n))) for n>=2, with n=1 explicitly finite and all outside constants absolute. The complete structured envelope preserves the actual polynomial allocation factor; its known exponential coefficient is45156545581/20000000000 and exact growth index1/2. No unknown inner coefficient is inferred.
